tasks.check: deno check src/main.ts && cd ui && deno install && deno run -A npm:typescript/tsc --noEmit -p .
tasks.ui:build: cd ui && deno install && deno run -A npm:vite build
tasks.ui:dev: cd ui && deno install && deno run -A npm:vite
tasks.compile: deno task ui:build && deno compile -A --include ui/dist --include dimos.yaml -o build/dimos-desktop src/main.ts
